title: Akiyama Mizuki — A Party With Everyone〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm here♪
Now I just need to find the others...
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is something the matter, Mizuki...?
I thought you and the others were throwing that after-party today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, Rin, perfect timing!
I need you two to come with me for a sec!
Diner

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mizuki, over here!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey! Sorry I'm a bit late!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it. Is everything okay?
You messaged us saying that something urgent came up...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's all squared away!
Thankfully, I made sure to leave home pretty early.
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Waitress
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
Here is your order!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, we get everything all at once?!
Oh, you made sure to order my curry and drink!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
As well as fries.
We had a feeling that you'd want some.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. And you're right!
Thanks a bunch!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anyway, since you have your food now, Mizuki, shall we get started?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, gimme one second.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Your phone? You don't usually take pictures, do you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Not a picture.
Hey, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Miku and the others?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They all have glasses of juice...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, they do...
Wait a second. That thing you had to do...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! That's right, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yes, I went over to SEKAI to deliver snacks and juice to everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Mizuki said we should come to the party too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We're celebrating you getting better too, after all! And Rin and the others all helped so much looking after you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Mizuki.
I should be the one thanking them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's no big deal♪ I just want us all to enjoy this happy occasion together!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, without further ado, Kanade, take it away!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I know this is coming a bit late, but here's to our new song being uploaded, as well as me getting better...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu, Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line:
Cheers.
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Co.
rows.Line: Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's dig in!
You guys have as many snacks as you like too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<O-Okay. Thanks, Mizuki...
Let's eat.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, where are MEIKO and KAITO?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <We invited them, but they didn't show up.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Well, that means more snacks for the rest of us, so I'm okay with it.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What are you having, Kanade?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Something nutritious?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Umm... I'm having this miso ramen, but I don't know how nutritious it is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, they do say that fermented foods are good for you. In theory, doesn't that include the miso used for this ramen?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line:
I dunno about that.
A-Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, remember that box I gave you? Now should be a good time to open it up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Okay...
I've been waiting for you to give me permission.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, what's inside?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You'll see.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<...? A red ribbon...
And what's this on the end? Something round and golden.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It's a medal!
I wanted to reward you for being such a great nurse!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Rin, you spent basically every day looking after me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, there's even an engraving...
It says, “Job well done!”>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Let me put it on you, Rin.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No, that's okay...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<It's not every day you get a medal.
Here, tilt your head down for me.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Congratulations, Rin...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Thanks, Mizuki...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. You deserve it.
And thanks again for looking after Kanade!
